rationale: Unchanged baseline components are FROZEN. Ablations R1/R2/R3/F1 are classified NEW_FROZEN_MODEL_INFERENCE_REQUIRED, NOT TRAINING_REQUIRED, because they can be expressed as controlled variants under the frozen protocol; however their EXECUTION is explicitly NOT authorized by this specification audit. If any future reviewer determines a variant genuinely requires additional training, it must STOP with PHASE28_BLOCKED__ABLATION_TRAINING_SPEC_INCOMPLETE until a training-authorized spec exists.
